data.title: 巴泽特·弗拉加·马克雷米兹 · 街口的手套
data.description: 夜里的街口很安静。巴泽特拉紧手套，确认前方没有行人后才准备穿过马路。
data.action: adjusting a glove while standing at a crossing
data.promptProse: Standing under the cool amber illumination of an ornate cast-iron gas streetlamp at a foggy cobbled intersection, Bazett methodically tugs and fastens the wrist-strap of her reinforced black leather combat glove. Dense night fog swirls through the quiet alleyways, catching the glow of lamplight on wet granite and her composed, vigilant stance.
